instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORT GOOGLE FONTS: Add 'Chakra Petch' and 'Share Tech Mono' to the HTML head or CSS imports.
BACKGROUND: Use the provided background image URL. Apply a heavy overlay (`bg-[#04080F]/80`) and heavy backdrop blur (`backdrop-blur-xl`) so it looks like an out-of-focus control room.
TACTICAL GRID: Create a fixed full-screen overlay with a repeating linear gradient to act as thin grid lines. Keep the opacity very low (e.g., 5-10%).

HEADER: Center the text 'E-ARMS'. Apply `font-family: 'Chakra Petch'` and `text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.8)`. Below it, add 'ECSAG AUTOMATED ROOM MANAGEMENT SYSTEM' in a smaller monospaced font with high tracking.

CENTER HUB: Create a circular div (e.g., w-32 h-32 or w-48 h-48). Use an inner green box-shadow for depth. Add a radar sweep animation using an absolute pseudo-element with `background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 70%, rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.6) 100%)` and a spinning keyframe animation (0 to 360deg).
RADIAL MENU (THE 5 BUTTONS): Arrange 5 absolute positioned buttons radially around the center hub.

TRAPEZOID SHAPE: Use `clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 85% 100%, 15% 100%)` for a wedge shape where the top (outer edge) is wider and the bottom (inner edge) is narrower. Note: Depending on orientation, you might need to adjust the polygon or rotate the button.
BUTTON MAPPING & ANGLES (Starting top, clockwise 72deg each):
Ensure each button reflects its assigned color via border-color or text glow, and has an icon.
HUD DETAILS: Add purely decorative 'tech overlays' to the corners of the screen (e.g., static coordinates, '[SYS.RDY]', or mini bar charts). Use absolute positioning.
Make sure all interactive elements include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., `data-testid='btn-new-booking'`).
Ensure responsiveness! The 9:16 layout means the radial menu must scale down on smaller mobile screens so the buttons don't overflow the viewport width.
